Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Williams
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 01/18/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 72 as introduced could reduce the advertising and bidding expenditures of city and county boards of education, and public educational entities by an undetermined amount, by allowing the boards of education and/or public educational entities to purchase goods or services for meals outside of the Child Nutrition Program of the Alabama State Department of Education (for up to 60 days) based on a recommendation of the State Superintendent of Education, during an emergency affecting health or safety, or causing supply chain disruption, and the approval of the Department of Examiners of Public Accounts.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs

Date: 03/07/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 72 as passed the Senate could reduce the advertising and bidding expenditures of city and county boards of education and public educational entities by an undetermined amount, by allowing these boards and entities to purchase goods or services for meals related to the Child Nutrition Program of the Alabama State Department of Education during an emergency affecting health or safety, or causing supply chain disruption, under certain conditions.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government
